question: In a statically determinate truss, which condition typically identifies a zero-force member?
options: Two non-collinear members forming a joint with no external load applied
Three collinear members meeting at a support
A member carrying a compression load greater than its buckling capacity
A vertical member at the center of a Pratt truss
hint: Summing forces at an unloaded joint with two non-collinear members requires both to be zero.
